{{Short description|American physicist (1938–2021)}}
{{Use mdy dates|date=August 2025}}
'''Donald J. Kouri''' (July 25, 1938 – February 9, 2021) was an American physicist and Cullen Distinguished Professor at the [[University of Houston]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.uh.edu/nsm/physics/people/profiles/donald-kouri/ |title=Donald Kouri |publisher=uh.edu |access-date=May 10, 2017}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=xWRcn_0AAAAJ&hl=en |title=Donald Kouri |access-date=May 10, 2017}}</ref>  He completed his PhD from [[University of Wisconsin–Madison|University of Wisconsin]] in 1965.

== Research interest ==
Donald J Kouri carried out research in the fundamental implications of the [[Heisenberg uncertainty principle]] and the resulting applications and also generalized [[Coherent states in mathematical physics|coherent states]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.uh.edu/nsm/physics/people/profiles/donald-kouri/|title=Faculty Profile: Donald J Kouri}}</ref> He has also pioneered the research in quantum theory of [[Atomic collision theory|atomic collisions]] and molecular collisions.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.uh.edu/ia/farfel/pages/dKouri.html|title=Farfel Recipient: Don Kouri}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|title=A tribute to Donald J. Kouri|journal = The Journal of Physical Chemistry A|volume = 107|issue = 37|pages = 7073–7075|doi=10.1021/jp030606k|year = 2003}}</ref>

He taught and carried out research in [[Israel]] and [[Germany]], and participated in international conferences throughout the world. Kouri died on February 9, 2021, at the age of 82.<ref>{{Cite web |title=In Memoriam: Professor Donald J. Kouri - University of Houston |url=https://www.uh.edu/nsm/physics/news-events/stories/2021/0222-kouri-memoriam.php |access-date=2024-03-10 |website=www.uh.edu}}</ref>

== Awards ==
* 2010: National Science Foundation's Special Creativity Award
* 1978: [[List of Guggenheim Fellowships awarded in 1978|Guggenheim Fellowship]] for Natural Sciences, US & Canada

== Works ==
* Kouri, Donald J (2015) ''Quantum Scattering Theory.'' World Scientific Publishing Company
* Kouri, Donald J and Shi, Zhouoer (2001) ''Lagrange Wavelets for Signal Processing''. IEEE 
* Kouri, Donald J. (1991). ''Theoretical studies of molecular collisions''. National Aeronautics and Space Administration
